decision: Owner decision (Option B of the 2026-11-24 strategic reset): strict blinding of the live holdout ends. The live mv1 ledger becomes a continuously monitored prospective benchmark. Outcomes are computed as they mature, stored openly in this repository and shown on the dashboard.

excludedSessions.reason: Permanently excluded from official prospective statistics (owner decision 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-24): the session has a retained R6 anomaly in ledger-state.json.

milestone: 250 completed live sessions remain a long-term research milestone, not a prerequisite for evaluation, rule development or promotion.
liveDataRole: A monitored prospective benchmark for mv1-8ecef864. It is NOT an untouched holdout for any rule developed after 2026-11-24: a new rule version is validated only on sessions after its own shadow start, compared with mv1 on the same sessions.

originalContract.note: holdout.json and protocol/od1.json are kept unchanged as the historical record of the original sealed contract (250-session gate, never unblinded). The OD1 definitions, thresholds and horizons are unchanged; only the blinding is ended, by this record.
